source_status: Author-supplied Supplementary Information. This metadata does not assert that the manuscript or SI has been formally published.
purpose: Representative interface examples only; not a training dataset, evaluation set, or basis for reproducing the reported metrics.
source_policy: Displayed contents of Supplementary Tables S2 and S7 were transcribed. In Table S7, records #2-#4 identify SiO2/Si supports; their Thermal Conductivity values were corrected from 149 to 1.4 after resolving the substrate-mapping precedence bug. Restricted row-level records, checkpoints and predictions are not included in the public examples.
transcription_rules: Each source table column becomes one CSV record; the fifteen descriptor names are mapped to the existing model interface without changing the values.

Numeric tokens retain the printed precision except documented MoS2 substrate-mapping corrections in Table S7. No hidden precision, additional records, inferred raw inputs, imputation or unit conversion is supplied.
The literal NA preserves a missing descriptor shown in Table S7. Empty target cells indicate that the target is not applicable to that dataset or is not disclosed in Table S2.
Line wrapping within DOI and Row ID cells is removed; all identifier characters are preserved.
sample_id, data_origin, source_table and dataset are release metadata. sample_id is a local example identifier, not a newly disclosed private dataset row identifier.
Table S7 is already mapped to the CNT-compatible descriptor interface; it is not a raw MoS2 synthesis table and must not be passed to the raw MoS2 mapping loader.

Table S7 corrections are documented in the source policy. The public examples contain only the representative values shown in the revised SI and do not include restricted row-level experiment records.
unit_policy: Units are recorded only when explicitly shown in the S2/S7 descriptor header. A null unit means not stated in these tables, not dimensionless. Other physical units are not inferred from descriptor names. For MoS2, preserved CNT-compatible column names do not establish equivalent physical meaning.
